newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu forms car financing venture in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Itochu forms car financing venture in Thailand.

text.p: Japanese trading company Itochu Corp said on Wednesday that it had set up a car financing joint venture in Thailand.

Thai Commercial Auto is capitalised at one billion baht and 25-percent owned by Itochu, a spokesman for the trading house said. The venture is also owned by Thai firms Tru-Way Co Ltd, Tun Thamrong Co Ltd and Leenutaphong Holding Co Ltd, he said.
The new company, to start operations later this month, will provide financing to buyers of European and American cars. More details were not immediately available.
